steps.title: Before the storm
steps.description: Calm. Rescue Services page shows the weekend forecast only; quiet news and social feeds.

steps.title: Orange storm surge warning
steps.description: Rescue Services issues an orange warning; the Herald writes a short preview story.

steps.title: Water on Coast Road
steps.description: First eyewitness posts of flooding; a new account claims Harbour Bridge has collapsed.

steps.title: Red warning, bridge closed
steps.description: Warning raised to red, Harbour Bridge closed as a precaution. The collapse rumour spreads (212 reposts); the Herald relays it as unverified.

steps.title: Saltmarsh evacuation, rumour debunked
steps.description: Update no. 4: Saltmarsh south of Ferry Street must leave by 16:00; Rescue Services says the bridge collapse is false.

steps.title: Premature all-clear
steps.description: Residents post that the water is going down. Rescue Services: no all-clear has been given.
